skill.name: video-downloader

content.value_statement: Saving permitted online videos can require careful format, quality, and organization choices. This skill structures download requests for individual videos, playlists, audio, and metadata.
actual_capabilities: Structures requests for downloading individual videos from supported platforms.
Supports requested quality levels such as 480p, 720p, 1080p, and 4K.
Supports MP4, WebM, and audio-only output requests.
Handles playlist and multi-URL batch download instructions.
Requests preservation of titles, descriptions, and thumbnails.
Provides concise progress and saved-file summaries.
limitations: The skill includes guidance only and does not bundle a downloader or platform integration.
Downloads require compatible external tools, network access, and adequate storage.
Available formats and quality depend on the source platform and original media.
Users must have permission and follow copyright laws and platform terms.

use_cases.title: Save Lessons Offline
use_cases.description: Download permitted tutorials or conference sessions for study without continuous internet access.

use_cases.title: Prepare Editing Sources
use_cases.description: Retrieve owned video or audio in a chosen format for an editing workflow.

use_cases.title: Archive Research Media
use_cases.description: Organize authorized videos with metadata and thumbnails for later reference.

prompt_templates.title: Download One Video
prompt_templates.prompt: Download this permitted video: [URL]. Save it as MP4 in my Downloads folder.
prompt_templates.scenario: A beginner needs a standard offline copy.

prompt_templates.title: Choose Video Quality
prompt_templates.prompt: Download this permitted video at [720p or 1080p]: [URL]. Report the final format, size, and saved location.
prompt_templates.scenario: The user wants control over quality and storage.

prompt_templates.title: Extract Audio
prompt_templates.prompt: Download audio from this permitted video: [URL]. Use MP3 and preserve the title and thumbnail when supported.
prompt_templates.scenario: The user needs an audio-only copy.

prompt_templates.title: Archive a Playlist
prompt_templates.prompt: Download this authorized playlist: [URL]. Use [quality], preserve metadata and thumbnails, skip existing files, and summarize failures.
prompt_templates.scenario: An advanced user needs a repeatable collection workflow.

output_examples.input: Download my video at 1080p and save the thumbnail.
output_examples.output: Downloaded the 1080p MP4 and thumbnail. The response lists both filenames, sizes, and the destination folder.

output_examples.input: Save the audio from this permitted lecture as MP3.
output_examples.output: Downloaded the MP3 with the lecture title. The response confirms duration, file size, and saved location.

output_examples.input: Archive this authorized playlist and skip files already present.
output_examples.output: Completed the playlist download. The response summarizes downloaded, skipped, and failed items without repeating existing files.

best_practices: Confirm download permission before processing any media.
Specify format, quality, destination, and metadata requirements in the request.
Check expected storage needs before downloading large videos or playlists.
anti_patterns: Do not download or redistribute copyrighted media without authorization.
Do not request maximum quality when storage or bandwidth is limited.
Do not submit large batches without defining failure handling and duplicate behavior.

faq.question: Does this skill include a video downloader?
faq.answer: No. It provides download workflow instructions and depends on compatible external tools available in the execution environment.

faq.question: Which platforms are supported?
faq.answer: The skill targets YouTube and other platforms supported by the available downloader. Actual coverage depends on that external tool.

faq.question: Can I select video quality?
faq.answer: Yes. Request 480p, 720p, 1080p, or 4K, subject to the quality available from the source.

faq.question: Can it download audio only?
faq.answer: Yes. Request an audio-only format such as MP3 when the external downloader supports conversion.

faq.question: Can it process playlists or several URLs?
faq.answer: Yes. The documented workflow supports playlist and batch requests, with results depending on external tool limits.

faq.question: What legal restrictions apply?
faq.answer: Download only media you own or may legally save. Follow copyright law, license terms, and platform rules.
